unsupported_claims.sentence: # “Fighter Jets That Won’t Attack” Are on the Way—Britain’s Support Has Another Side
unsupported_claims.reason: The ledger records the Ministry of Defence’s announcement of a future defensive mission, but does not establish that the jets are already on their way.

unsupported_claims.sentence: Britain is sending fighter jets, but they will not attack the other side.
unsupported_claims.reason: The ledger supports an announced future Typhoon mission, not the claim that the jets have already been dispatched or are en route.

unsupported_claims.sentence: This time, the story is not only about the fighter jets arriving.
unsupported_claims.reason: The ledger describes an announced future mission and does not establish that the jets have arrived.
